title: Lower Than the Angels
alt: A pink stippled engraving of a draped woman with butterfly-like wings, the words “Lower Than The Angels” running down her body, framed by pink and black art-nouveau scrollwork and halftone close-ups of an eye and lips.

title: Gangsta of the Mass Awakening
alt: A title card reading “Gangsta of the Mass Awakening” in dithered yellow letters on deep blue, tangled in pink and green tribal filigree.

title: Flicks - Frou Frou (Static Frame)
alt: Spotted orchids set into a pink baroque hand mirror and an art-nouveau line panel, over a marbled green-to-magenta ground.

title: Women Devour Women
alt: A poster reading “Women Devour / Women Devour Devour Women” in halftone bubble letters, around a black filigree crest over a magenta wash with a mirrored face and embossed crosses.

title: Self-Collage
alt: A dithered collage of red coral-like filigree climbing over pink and orange body forms around a faceted crystal, in a coarse halftone.

title: The Marian Blood Covenant (Static Frame)
alt: A veiled face behind magenta filigree ornaments and a band of blue baroque shapes, with pink and red glitch lettering running down both sides and a white “(C) 2004”.

title: Genji
alt: Two nude figures, one lilac and one blue with green hair, lie head to foot across a red and patterned blue rug, a crystalline wing at the corner.

title: Aponia
alt: A blonde figure in a white coat raises a hand over her face while a tiny red figure hangs from it, thorned wire wrapped around the sleeve, on a ground of green and red brushwork.

title: Because Your Lips are Yours, I Forgive Their Cruel Joke
alt: Two figures kiss, seen through a gilded ornamental mirror frame, while small blue fairy figures cling to its edges.

title: The Rape of Melchora
alt: A nude figure lies upside down on a blue checkerboard floor, hands pressed over the face, a red rosary looped across the arms, while robed figures watch from the back.

title: The Satyress and the Shepherd (V1)
alt: A pale figure with pan pipes beneath a scribbled dark-blue halo, over an ochre ground layered with red and blue line sketches of other figures.

title: Persephone
alt: A long-haired nude figure with closed eyes cradles a snarling wolf's head before a split pomegranate, on a lilac patterned wall framed by poppies and orchids, with an inset of a skull covered in moths.

title: Portrait of an Unassuming Mermaid
alt: A mermaid with curly blonde hair and teal braids holds up a string of pearls, half caught in a rope net, flanked by two lilac cherub statues, with shells and a starfish in a purple border.

title: The Sun and the Moon: Two Households, Both Alike in Dignity
alt: Two figures press together in a kiss, one a blazing golden flame of hair and light, the other with flowing teal and violet tentacle-like hair, before a pink rising-sun burst of rays.
